articles.summary: A new report from independent research firm Verdantix shows how quickly the utility technology market is changing. As flexibility moves into the core of utility customer operations, the systems that manage customers increasingly need to understand the energy assets in each home, and how those assets interact with markets and the grid. Verdantix's assessment of 14 utility customer platform providers shows where the market is heading, and where Enode stands out.
articles.title: Independent research confirms Enode’s role in the residential flexibility market

articles.summary: Connected capacity only matters if it responds when you need it. Reliable dispatch comes from having the scale and breadth to make thousands of different devices move together.
articles.title: The real measure of flexibility
